evals.prompt: /skillify — build a new orama-system skill that rotates API keys in our secrets manager. Target claude-code. It has to ask first before touching anything in prod, and it should register as a sub-skill of orama-system when I confirm.
evals.expected_output: Intake questions only for missing facts, clobber guard run before any write, smallest folder shape for a side-effect-bearing skill (SKILL.md + instructions/ + references/ + eval/), disable-model-invocation: true in frontmatter, an explicit Ask First boundary for prod key rotation, registration proposed only after confirmation, and a STATUS: DONE report with validation results.

evals.prompt: skillify feels stale. Go check your own SKILL.md against your own standards (skill-architecture-guide.md, modular-skill-authoring.md, skill-folder-template.md) and against Anthropic's skill-creator standards, and fix what's actually wrong -- don't just rewrite everything.
evals.expected_output: A scoped diff, not a full rewrite: concrete missing pieces identified (e.g. no examples/, no eval/) and fixed; anything already compliant left untouched; any place where Anthropic's skill-creator standard and this repo's own architecture guide disagree is named explicitly rather than silently resolved.

evals.prompt: We have an onboarding runbook living in the retiring-fellow .claude/skills library that new engineers keep asking for. Adapt it into bin/orama-system/skills/onboarding/ following the retiring-fellow-skill-library.md rules.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 discovery before writing (reads README, existing skills, docs/v2 references), Phase 2 reuse-before-create check against the existing skill matrix, correct target path under bin/orama-system/skills/ (never .claude/skills/), an audit note appended, and a STATUS report matching the retiring-fellow-skill-library.md Output Report format.
